cues.en: Hello, and welcome back.
cues.zh: 你好，歡迎回來。

cues.en: Today, we've got exciting tutorial.
cues.zh: 今天有堂精彩教學。

cues.en: We're talking about target encoding.
cues.zh: 要談目標編碼。

cues.en: When we are working with a dataset that has a categorical variable, we normally use one-hot encoding, and this means taking that variable and exchanging it
cues.zh: 資料集有類別變數時，通常做獨熱編碼，也就是取這個變數，換成

cues.en: for a certain number of dummy variables.
cues.zh: 一定數量的虛擬變數。

cues.en: Well, the number of dummy variables equals to the number of categories, one per category, and then you drop the last dummy variable to avoid the dummy variable trap.
cues.zh: 數量等於類別數，每類一個，再刪最後一個，避免虛擬變數陷阱。

cues.en: But let's say we have lots, or let's say you have three categories instead of two.
cues.zh: 假設類別較多，先說有三類，不是兩類。

cues.en: Well, now we're going to have to create three dummy variables, drop the last one.
cues.zh: 就要建三個虛擬變數，再刪最後一個。

cues.en: But what if we have many more dummy variables?
cues.zh: 如果更多虛擬變數呢？

cues.en: Well, we're going to have to create.
cues.zh: 就必須建立……

cues.en: What if we have many more categories?
cues.zh: 應該說，如果有更多類別？

cues.en: We're gonna have to create many more dummy variables, and of course, drop one.
cues.zh: 就要更多虛擬變數，當然刪一個。

cues.en: So if you have like 100 categories, you'll end up with 99 dummy variables or 99 columns instead of just one.
cues.zh: 100 類，最後 99 個虛擬變數，也就是一欄變 99 欄。

cues.en: And this can pose certain issues, so issues of one-hot encoding.
cues.zh: 可能產生一些問題，看看獨熱編碼的問題。

cues.en: The first one is, as we can see, it's an exploding number of dummy variables.
cues.zh: 第一，虛擬變數數量暴增。

cues.en: Number two is it's hard to assess feature importance of the original feature, for example, in this case, Country.
cues.zh: 第二，難評估原始特徵的重要性，例如這裡的 Country。

cues.en: So you can assess, once you've done your modeling, you can go and assess, oh, how important is this feature?
cues.zh: 建模後，可以評估這個新特徵多重要，

cues.en: Or how important is this feature?
cues.zh: 或那個特徵多重要。

cues.en: You can do that, but it'll be hard to assess, well, how important this feature was because it no longer exists in your final data set that you're actually modeling.
cues.zh: 但難評估原始特徵有多重要，因為最後建模資料裡已不存在。

cues.en: So you'd have to do mathematical operations with these and their results to get to how important this feature is, and that's not straightforward.
cues.zh: 需要對這些變數與結果做數學運算，才能回推，不直接。

cues.en: The next one is, it doesn't work well with tree-based algorithms for the following reasons.
cues.zh: 再來，對樹型演算法不太理想，原因如下。

cues.en: One is it forces trees to split by individual categories.
cues.zh: 迫使樹逐個類別分割。

cues.en: So you cannot combine two of these categories.
cues.zh: 不能把兩個類別組合。

cues.en: You cannot say, "Oh, well, in the tree branches."
cues.zh: 不能在樹分支說，

cues.en: You cannot say, if the category is Monaco or Spain, then go left, otherwise go right.
cues.zh: 類別是 Monaco 或 Spain 就往左，否則往右。

cues.en: No, you can only do, if it's Monaco, yes or no.
cues.zh: 只能問，是不是 Monaco？

cues.en: If it's Spain, yes or no.
cues.zh: 是不是 Spain？

cues.en: So it limits how the tree can be built.
cues.zh: 限制建樹方式。

cues.en: Also, lots of sparse columns, as we can see.
cues.zh: 也會有許多稀疏欄。

cues.en: Lots of zeros in here, and you can lose or you will lose ordinal information.
cues.zh: 大量 0，而且會失去序位資訊。

cues.en: So for example, if you have High School, Bachelor, Masters, PhD, which have an order to them or a sequence, a hierarchy in which they come, it can be useful for the modeling,
cues.zh: 例如高中、學士、碩士、博士，本來有順序與階層，對模型可能有用，

cues.en: but once you convert them to dummy variables like this, you're going to lose that information.
cues.zh: 但變成這樣的虛擬變數後，就失去順序資訊。

cues.en: And there's computational inefficiency because more features means the algorithm must evaluate more potential splits at each node,
cues.zh: 運算也較沒效率，因為特徵多，每個節點要評估更多候選分割，

cues.en: and that can slow down the training.
cues.zh: 可能拖慢訓練。

cues.en: Now having said that, please note that one-hot encoding is not all terrible.
cues.zh: 不過，獨熱編碼不是完全不好。

cues.en: It actually works well with a certain models that include dot products or matrix multiplications, such as linear models and neural networks.
cues.zh: 它適合涉及內積或矩陣乘法的模型，例如線性模型與神經網路。

cues.en: And there's a link down there below if you'd like to explore this further and read a bit about it.
cues.zh: 下方有連結，可以進一步探索閱讀。

cues.en: Now, what do we do in the case that if one-hot encoding isn't working well with our model?
cues.zh: 如果模型不適合獨熱編碼，怎麼辦？

cues.en: Well, we're going to look at an alternative, and one of those alternatives is called target encoding.
cues.zh: 看替代方法，其中之一是目標編碼。

cues.en: And here's how we're going to attack this topic.
cues.zh: 會這樣介紹。

cues.en: First, we're going to talk about the simple average target encoding.
cues.zh: 先談簡單平均目標編碼。

cues.en: Then we're gonna talk about weighted average target encoding.
cues.zh: 再談加權平均目標編碼。

cues.en: We'll talk about data leakage and what it is, and then we'll talk about K-Fold target encoding.
cues.zh: 討論資料洩漏是什麼，再談 k 折目標編碼。

cues.en: So let's dive straight into it.
cues.zh: 直接開始。

cues.en: So simple average targeting encoding, Here are our countries, and for simplicity's sake, we're going to assume that this is on the whole of our dataset.
cues.zh: 簡單平均目標編碼。這些是國家，簡單起見，假設這就是全部資料集。

cues.en: Of course, in real life, the dataset would be much higher, larger with thousands or tens of thousands of columns, of rows, I mean of rows.
cues.zh: 實際資料當然更大，可能有數千、數萬欄，應該說列，是列。

cues.en: But we'll assume this is all of our dataset.
cues.zh: 但先假設這是全部。

cues.en: And let's say this dataset has customers and how much they spent in our store, and we want to predict, so let's say how much they spent in our store last year,
cues.zh: 資料有顧客與店內消費金額，假設是去年消費，

cues.en: and we want to predict how much they'll spend in our online store this year.
cues.zh: 想預測今年在網路商店會花多少。

cues.en: So this is for an online store.
cues.zh: 這是網路商店。

cues.en: So this is our target.
cues.zh: 這是目標值。

cues.en: This is in dollars or euros or pounds, however you like, or rupees.
cues.zh: 單位可美元、歐元、英鎊，或盧比。

cues.en: Whatever you like, this is that amount.
cues.zh: 任你選，就是消費金額。

cues.en: This is the currency spent, and this is where they're from.
cues.zh: 這是花的金額，這是來自哪裡。

cues.en: And there's more columns, of course, but we're focusing on this column.
cues.zh: 當然還有其他欄，但先看這欄。

cues.en: So what going to do in target encoding is we're going to take the average of our target because that's what we're predicting.
cues.zh: 目標編碼會取目標值平均，因為這是要預測的。

cues.en: We're going to take the average of our target, and we're going to, for each country, in this case, Germany, so we'll take across all the customers in our dataset who have Germany as the country,
cues.zh: 針對每個國家，例如 Germany，取所有 Country 為 Germany 的顧客，

cues.en: we'll take the average, and then we'll replace Germany with that average.
cues.zh: 計算目標平均，再用平均替換 Germany。

cues.en: I know it sounds bizarre.
cues.zh: 聽起來很奇怪。

cues.en: The first time I saw it, I also was.
cues.zh: 我第一次看到也……

cues.en: If you're feeling confused, I was also very confused.
cues.zh: 如果你困惑，我當時也非常困惑。

cues.en: Like, how can we replace a categorical variable or like a discrete variable with a continuous variable?
cues.zh: 類別變數、離散變數，怎麼能換成連續變數？

cues.en: How does this even make sense?
cues.zh: 怎麼合理？

cues.en: Well, believe it or not, it actually works.
cues.zh: 信不信由你，確實有效。

cues.en: And this is the method.
cues.zh: 方法就是這樣。

cues.en: Basically, we're showing how Germany relates to this target.
cues.zh: 基本上表示 Germany 與目標的關係。

cues.en: And the best way or the simplest way to think about it is to take the average, and let's put it in here, but bear with me for some time, and let's see how this plays out.
cues.zh: 最簡單方式，就是平均，再放進這裡。先耐心看結果。

cues.en: We're gonna take the next one.
cues.zh: 再看下一個。

cues.en: We gonna take France, take the average of our target, and put it instead of France in our column.
cues.zh: France 也取目標平均，替換欄中的 France。

cues.en: We're gonna take the next one, Spain, and we'll take the average, put in the term instead of Spain in our column.
cues.zh: 再是 Spain，取平均，替換欄中的 Spain。

cues.en: And that is simple average encoding.
cues.zh: 就是簡單平均編碼。

cues.en: So those are the results that we get over here.
cues.zh: 這是得到的結果。

cues.en: Now we're going to expand this a bit more, and we're gonna make this broader.
cues.zh: 再擴展、一般化一些。

cues.en: We're gonna talk about weighted average target encoding,
cues.zh: 談加權平均目標編碼。

cues.en: so as you'll see, simple average encoding is a subset of weighted average encoding, weighted average target encoding.
cues.zh: 你會看到，簡單平均是加權平均目標編碼的特例。

cues.en: So here is our dataset.
cues.zh: 這是資料集。

cues.en: Now, instead of just taking average, we're gonna use this formula where the encoded value of a certain category, Category A, is the sum of the target.
cues.zh: 不再只取平均，而用這個公式：類別 A 的編碼值，先取該類別目標總和。

cues.en: So we're gonna take the sum here.
cues.zh: 就是這裡的總和。

cues.en: We're going to add w, w is a hyperparameter, times the average of all of the whole target
cues.zh: 再加 w 乘以全部目標的平均，w 是超參數，

cues.en: and divided by the number of Category A's we see plus w.
cues.zh: 再除以類別 A 的筆數加 w。

cues.en: So NCat is the number of categories of that row.
cues.zh: N_Cat 代表該列所屬類別的筆數。

cues.en: Like, let's say we're dealing with Germany, that'll be number of Germany before, and w is the hyperparameter.
cues.zh: 例如 Germany，就是 Germany 出現次數，w 是超參數。

cues.en: So if w is equals to 0, just imagine you put a 0 here, it'll be a 0 here as well, then you'll just have Sum Target A, to Sum Target of Category A.
cues.zh: w = 0 時，這裡與這裡都是 0，只剩類別 A 的目標總和，

cues.en: So you'll have Sum of for Germany, 82, 31, 251, 75.
cues.zh: 例如 Germany 的 82、31、251、75，

cues.en: You add them up, and you divide by the numbers.
cues.zh: 相加，再除以筆數。

cues.en: Germany, Germany, Germany, divide by four.
cues.zh: Germany 有四筆，除以 4。

cues.en: Then you will get your simple average formula, the simple average that we were using.
cues.zh: 就得到原先使用的簡單平均公式。

cues.en: For illustration purposes, we're gonna assume w is equal to 2, and what that does is it adds over here.
cues.zh: 示範假設 w = 2，它會在這裡加入，

cues.en: Basically, it adds a a modifier, and that is the average of all of these values.
cues.zh: 一個修正，也就是這些值的整體平均。

cues.en: And basically, that helps in the cases where you have very few values.
cues.zh: 對筆數很少的類別有幫助。

cues.en: You know, like if you don't have, like, a lot of values for certain category for like France,
cues.zh: 例如 France 沒很多值，

cues.en: it won't be like too sensitive in the sense that maybe this is just an outlier.
cues.zh: 就不會太敏感，也許這筆只是離群值。

cues.en: It won't be too sensitive to that because it's going to be diluted by the overall average.
cues.zh: 因為整體平均會稀釋影響。

cues.en: So let's see how this works in practice.
cues.zh: 看實際如何運作。

cues.en: So actually, we're not gonna do the calculations for all of them.
cues.zh: 不會逐個手算。

cues.en: I've done them here separately.
cues.zh: 我另外算好了。

cues.en: We're not going to spend time calculating them.
cues.zh: 不花時間計算。

cues.en: If you'd like to calculate them on your own, here's the formula.
cues.zh: 想自己算，公式在這裡。

cues.en: And here are the results that I got, and you can double-check them.
cues.zh: 這是我的結果，可以再檢查。

cues.en: And basically once you do that, you just replace the country with the categories in here, sorry, the countries with these numerical values.
cues.zh: 做完就用這些數字，替換國家類別。

cues.en: So that's weighted average target encoding.
cues.zh: 這就是加權平均目標編碼。

cues.en: That's how it works.
cues.zh: 運作如此。

cues.en: Now, a question that you might have and fairly so, is there data leakage?
cues.zh: 你可能合理地問：有資料洩漏嗎？

cues.en: Whether we're using weighted average target encoding or simple average target encoding, is there data leakage?
cues.zh: 不論加權平均還是簡單平均，有洩漏嗎？

cues.en: So Germany, the number that we want to predict is 82.
cues.zh: Germany 想預測的數字是 82。

cues.en: How can we train an algorithm?
cues.zh: 如何訓練演算法？

cues.en: How are we going to train a model if this value actually already includes 82, right?
cues.zh: 特徵值已包含 82，怎麼訓練？

cues.en: So it was part of that calculation, that 82, and in here.
cues.zh: 82 就參與了這個計算。

cues.en: So it's kind of like knowing what the result is going to be, and isn't that model going to be, like, seeing kind of like
cues.zh: 好像已經知道結果，模型是不是在訓練時，

cues.en: the variable that it wants to predict in training, it's actually going to have access to it through the features that it's using to predict that variable.
cues.zh: 透過用來預測的特徵，接觸到了想預測的變數？

cues.en: So it's going to be a useless model because it just already knows the answer.
cues.zh: 那模型會沒用，因為已知答案。

cues.en: What's the point of predicting anything?
cues.zh: 預測還有什麼意義？

cues.en: Well, that is an entirely valid approach.
cues.zh: 這完全是合理的疑慮。

cues.en: So we need to remove this data leakage or reduce it.
cues.zh: 所以要移除或減少洩漏。

cues.en: In some cases, weighted average target encoding will work fine.
cues.zh: 某些情況，加權平均目標編碼仍能運作。

cues.en: And even though there is data leakage, indeed, but if you need to reduce it, this is what you can use.
cues.zh: 即使有洩漏，但若需要降低，可以用下面方法。

cues.en: You can use K-Fold target encoding, and the way it works is you split your data into K-Fold.
cues.zh: k 折目標編碼，將資料分成 k 折。

cues.en: In this case, K equals to 2.
cues.zh: 這裡 k = 2。

cues.en: We're splitting into twofold, like two parts which are not overlapping and which are about the same size.
cues.zh: 分成兩份，不重疊、大小接近。

cues.en: And we're going to do something very cool.
cues.zh: 接著很有意思。

cues.en: We're going to calculate the weighted average target encoding on one fold, but then apply it to the other fold.
cues.zh: 在一折算加權平均目標編碼，卻套用另一折。

cues.en: So we calculated the weighted average for Germany using this and plus, you know, the modifier over here, across the average of these, not the full dataset, just of this fold.
cues.zh: 用這些 Germany 值，以及修正項，計算平均；整體平均也只算這折，不是全資料。

cues.en: So we're treating each fold like a separate dataset, but then the results that we get for the parameters or for the categories, we apply to the other fold, to the other fold or folds, right?
cues.zh: 把每折當獨立資料集，但算出的各類別結果，套到另一折，或其他折。

cues.en: If you split it into, let's say three folds or four folds, then you would calculate it here, and well, actually you would calculate it across.
cues.zh: 三折、四折時，會在這裡算，應該說跨折計算。

cues.en: Let's say if you had three folds, you would have to calculate across two folds.
cues.zh: 例如三折，要在兩折計算。

cues.en: Let's say you had another fold up top here, you would calculate across these two folds, and you would apply it to this third fold, right?
cues.zh: 假設上面多一折，就用這兩折算，套第三折。

cues.en: So you basically calculate the weighted average on all of the data except for the fold that you want to encode.
cues.zh: 基本上，用除了要編碼那一折之外的全部資料計算加權平均。

cues.en: So here, in this case, this is this last fold.
cues.zh: 這裡要編碼的是最後一折。

cues.en: So there it is.
cues.zh: 就在這裡。

cues.en: We calculated it.
cues.zh: 算好了。

cues.en: We put it in there, France, then we put it in here, and then we calculated the weighted average for Germany.
cues.zh: 放進這裡，France 也放進這裡，再算 Germany 加權平均。

cues.en: We put it in here.
cues.zh: 放進這裡。

cues.en: France, we put it in here.
cues.zh: France 也放這裡。

cues.en: We don't have one for Spain, but luckily, our formula accounts for that.
cues.zh: 沒有 Spain，但公式剛好能處理。

cues.en: So in Spain, we'll just use the average that comes from, like, if you basically still plug zero in for Spain into the formula,
cues.zh: Spain 就使用平均，基本上把 Spain 的筆數與總和代 0，

cues.en: it will work, and you get the average that is just basically the average of these values.
cues.zh: 公式仍可運作，得到這些值的整體平均。

cues.en: And there you go.
cues.zh: 就是這樣。

cues.en: So those are the values.
cues.zh: 這些是編碼值。

cues.en: We're not going to go into maths to calculate them here in.
cues.zh: 不在這裡深入數學計算。

cues.en: Just conceptually, we will get some numeric values that will go here.
cues.zh: 概念上，會得到放進這裡的數值。

cues.en: And keep in mind that here K equals to two, we can increase K to increase the number of subset or number of folds, if you'd like.
cues.zh: 記得目前 k = 2，也可以增加子集、折的數量。

cues.en: And as mentioned, if you have more than two, if you have three folds, let's say you have a third fold here, then you would apply the weighted average to these two folds to populate it here.
cues.zh: 超過兩折，例如有第三折，就用這兩折的加權平均填這裡。

cues.en: Then to populate it in this one, you apply the weighted average to the combination of this fold and this fold, and then to populate this fold, you'd apply the weighted average to these two folds combined.
cues.zh: 填這一折時，用另外兩折；填另一折，就用剩下兩折。

cues.en: And question about data leakage, this method actually helps prevent or at least reduce data leakage because, you know, this value never saw this value
cues.zh: 關於洩漏，這方法能避免或至少減少，因為算這個值時，沒看過自己的目標值，

cues.en: as calculated as an average of the other values.
cues.zh: 而是其他資料的平均。

cues.en: It's not ideal.
cues.zh: 不是理想完美。

cues.en: It doesn't completely remove data leakage.
cues.zh: 不會完全消除洩漏。

cues.en: But the interesting thing in machine learning is that it doesn't have to be perfect.
cues.zh: 但機器學習有趣的是，不必完美。

cues.en: Even if there is some data leakage during training, we don't mind as long as it works.
cues.zh: 講者認為，即使訓練時有少量資料洩漏，只要有效就可以接受。

cues.en: Machine learning is about results, not about perfection.
cues.zh: 機器學習重成果，不是完美。

cues.en: Something to keep in mind.
cues.zh: 值得記住。

cues.en: So there we go.
cues.zh: 就是這樣。

cues.en: That's how targeted encoding works.
cues.zh: 這是目標編碼的運作。

cues.en: If you'd like to learn a bit more about it, there's a great video by Josh Starmer from StatQuest on YouTube.
cues.zh: 想了解更多，推薦 YouTube StatQuest 的 Josh Starmer 影片。

cues.en: It's called "One-Hot, Label, Target, and K-Fold Target Encoding, Clearly Explained!!!"
cues.zh: 叫做 One-Hot, Label, Target, and K-Fold Target Encoding, Clearly Explained!!!。

cues.en: And you can practice a bit more with that video.
cues.zh: 可以透過影片再練習。

cues.en: On that note, I look forward to seeing you back here next time.
cues.zh: 期待下次見。

cues.en: Until then, enjoy machine learning.
cues.zh: 在那之前，享受機器學習的樂趣吧。
